assessment_dependencies.existing_product: Requires at least one reviewed example
assessment_dependencies.learning_transform: Capability intention can have no example; task-form requirements require matching reviewed examples
assessment_dependencies.new_bounded_contract: Reviewed examples are not necessary to restate explicitly reviewed equivalent canonical skill meaning; required before task-form or assessed-success claims

generic_concepts: conceptual understanding, capability and supported task-form requirements

optional_for_this_scope: trusted snapshot (required for publication, not reviewable evidence construction)
assessment examples (required for task-form or scored criteria)
concept graph (required for conceptual claims, not a bounded skill restatement)
policy_decision.partial_coverage: Whole selected scope review-required if any objective lacks evidence; explicitly select a smaller independently qualified target
required: valid capability package and exact source selection
every selected objective must have one unambiguous equivalent mapping with matching recorded human decision and canonical wording
policy_decision.success_criteria: Unavailable; no rubric or threshold in current evidence
policy_decision.trust_boundary: Historical human decision authenticates only canonical mapping/description in the pinned prototype; never approves uploaded source or publishes this new spec
